title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
description: Nintendo's Switch 2 rebuild of the 1998 adventure, out on 5 November 2026. The same dungeon crawl through Hyrule, with rebuilt scenes and a control scheme made for current hardware.

alt: Cover art for World of Warcraft: Forever
title: World of Warcraft: Forever
description: Blizzard's permanent mode for World of Warcraft, launched on 4 November 2026. Horizontal progression, new race and class combinations, and more than a thousand new quests.

alt: Cover art for Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
description: Pipeworks and Digital Eclipse rebuilt the 2002 kaiju brawler in Unreal Engine 5. Released on 3 November 2026 with online matches, dynamic weather and a roster of twelve monsters.

title: Casualties: Unknown
description: Orsoniks' squad game, released on 9 November 2026. Early player reviews on Steam sit near 98 percent positive across the first thousand ratings.

title: Aviassembly
description: A plane-building sim released on 12 November 2026. About 96 percent of the first ten thousand Steam reviews recommend it.

title: Elden Ring
description: FromSoftware's open-world action RPG created in collaboration with George R. R. Martin. Explore the Lands Between, defeat demigods, and uncover the mysteries of the Elden Ring.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Larian Studios' story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship, betrayal, survival, and absolute power.
